description: Puts an app's pre back to an earlier version, or moves the app with its history into the developer's own repo. More: neblla_get_llms tools/versions

action.description: By action: pre {every save burst is a commit}; restore {commit, branch?}; migrate {url, toBranch?, toProBranch?}

branch.description: For history / files / restore: which environment's branch

commit.description: The version sha, from "history" — required for files/restore

toBranch.description: For "migrate": pre's branch in THEIR repo (default "main")

toProBranch.description: For "migrate": pro's branch in THEIR repo (default "neblla-pro")

url.description: For "migrate": the developer own repo, github.com/owner/repo
